camera.reason: Single 50MP f/1.6 main camera with no OIS and no ultrawide.

performance.reason: Helio G200 is smooth in daily use and handles casual gaming.

battery.reason: 5,160mAh with 45W charging gets to 50% in about 22 minutes.

display.reason: 6.78 inch 1.5K AMOLED at 144Hz with 1,600 nits in high brightness mode.

build.reason: Very slim 6.6mm plastic body with a Gorilla Glass 7i front and IP64.

software.reason: Infinix promises 3 major Android upgrades and 5 years of security patches.

value.reason: The sharpest and fastest refreshing screen in the bracket at 66,500, with a 3.5mm jack and NFC.

availability.reason: In stock at PriceOye (Titanium Silver only) and Mega.pk, with official Infinix warranty.

notes: On 2026-10-10 PriceOye had only the Titanium Silver colour in stock; other colours were sold out. Mega.pk lists it at 73,999 and WhatMobile shows the official price as 77,999.
